SELECT
    *
FROM
    object
INNER JOIN
    probability
ON
    object.oid = probability.oid
WHERE
    object.firstMJD > 60173.0
    and object.firstMJD < 60177.0
    AND probability.class_name='SN'
    AND probability.classifier_name='stamp_classifier'
    AND probability.ranking=1
    AND (probability.probability>0.5
    OR object.ndet>1)

sql_query:
-- Query all objects first classified as SN by the stamp classifier between August 17 and August 21 (MJD 60173.0 to 60177.0),
-- with probability > 0.5 OR at least two detections

SELECT *
FROM object
WHERE oid IN (
    -- Subquery: get oids of objects classified as SN by stamp_classifier with ranking=1 and probability>0.5
    SELECT p.oid
    FROM probability p
    WHERE p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
      AND p.class_name = 'SN'
      AND p.ranking = 1
      AND p.probability > 0.5
      AND p.oid IN (
          -- Only consider objects whose firstmjd is in the specified range
          SELECT o.oid
          FROM object o
          WHERE o.firstmjd >= 60173.0 AND o.firstmjd <= 60177.0
      )
    UNION
    -- Subquery: get oids of objects classified as SN by stamp_classifier with ranking=1 and at least two detections
    SELECT p.oid
    FROM probability p
    WHERE p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
      AND p.class_name = 'SN'
      AND p.ranking = 1
      AND p.oid IN (
          SELECT o.oid
          FROM object o
          WHERE o.firstmjd >= 60173.0 AND o.firstmjd <= 60177.0
            AND o.ndet >= 2
      )
)

-- Return information for objects classified by the lc_classifier as most likely Cepheid (CEP), with probability > 0.76 and ndet >= 100
SELECT 
    o.oid,
    o.meanra,
    o.meandec,
    o.ndet,
    o.firstmjd,
    o.deltajd,
    o.g_r_max,
    p.classifier_name,
    p.class_name,
    p.ranking,
    p.probability
FROM object o
WHERE o.ndet >= 100
  AND o.oid IN (
      SELECT p1.oid
      FROM probability p1
      WHERE p1.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
        AND p1.class_name = 'CEP'
        AND p1.ranking = 1
        AND p1.probability > 0.76
  )
  -- Now get all classes for these objects under lc_classifier
  -- (including CEP and others)
  -- by joining to probability table in a nested query
  -- (avoiding explicit JOIN as per instructions)
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM probability p
      WHERE p.oid = o.oid
        AND p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
  )
-- Now select all classes for these objects
-- (using a lateral subquery to get all classes for each oid)
-- But since explicit JOINs are discouraged, use a WHERE IN subquery:
AND o.oid IN (
    SELECT p2.oid
    FROM probability p2
    WHERE p2.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
)
-- Now, for each object, select all classes from probability table
-- (using a correlated subquery in the SELECT list)
-- But since only columns from object and probability are needed,
-- use a subquery in FROM to get all relevant probability rows
-- for the selected oids:
ORDER BY o.oid, p.ranking

    WHERE p1.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND p1.class_name = 'CEP'
      AND p1.ranking = 1
      AND p1.probability > 0.76
)

    p.ranking,

-- Get all objects classified as AGN with probability > 0.6 by the light curve classifier,
-- with light curves covering at least one year (deltajd >= 365), 
-- at least 20 detections in at least one band,
-- and showing corrected magnitude variations >1 in g band and >0.5 in r band.
-- Return requested columns, with filter id columns aliased as [table_name]_fid.

SELECT
    o.oid,
    f.value,
    f.name,
    f.version,
    f.fid AS feature_fid,
    o.meanra,
    o.meandec,
    o.ndet,
    -- Maximum and minimum corrected magnitudes in g and r bands
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_g,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_g,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_r,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_r,
    -- Delta mag for g and r bands
    (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END)) AS delta_mag_g,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END)) AS delta_mag_r
FROM
    object o
WHERE
    o.oid IN (
        -- Subquery: select oids of objects classified as AGN with probability > 0.6 and ranking=1 by lc_classifier
        SELECT p.oid
        FROM probability p
        WHERE
            p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
            AND p.class_name = 'AGN'
            AND p.probability > 0.6
            AND p.ranking = 1
    )
    AND o.deltajd >= 365 -- light curve covers at least one year
    AND o.oid IN (
        -- Subquery: select oids with at least 20 detections in at least one band (g or r)
        SELECT oid
        FROM feature
        WHERE name = 'n_det' AND (fid = 1 OR fid = 2) AND value >= 20
        GROUP BY oid
    )
    AND o.oid IN (
        -- Subquery: select oids with delta_mag_g > 1 and delta_mag_r > 0.5 (using corrected magnitudes)
        SELECT oid
        FROM (
            SELECT
                oid,
                MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'max_mag' AND fid = 1 THEN value END) AS max_mag_g,
                MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'min_mag' AND fid = 1 THEN value END) AS min_mag_g,
                MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'max_mag' AND fid = 2 THEN value END) AS max_mag_r,
                MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'min_mag' AND fid = 2 THEN value END) AS min_mag_r
            FROM feature
            WHERE ( (name = 'max_mag' AND (fid = 1 OR fid = 2)) OR (name = 'min_mag' AND (fid = 1 OR fid = 2)) )
            GROUP BY oid
        ) t
        WHERE
            (max_mag_g - min_mag_g) > 1
            AND (max_mag_r - min_mag_r) > 0.5
    )

-- Get all objects classified as AGN with probability > 0.6 (lc_classifier, ranking=1)
-- Light curve coverage >= 365 days (object.deltajd >= 365)
-- At least 20 detections in at least one band (feature.name='n_det', value >= 20)
-- Variation in g band (fid=1): delta_mag > 1 (using corrected mags: delta_mag = max_mag_corr - min_mag_corr)
-- Variation in r band (fid=2): delta_mag > 0.5 (using corrected mags)
-- Return: oid, feature.value, feature.name, feature.version, feature.fid as feature_fid, meanra, meandec, ndet, max_mag_corr, min_mag_corr, delta_mag (for both bands, with fid info)

WITH agn_oids AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND class_name = 'AGN'
      AND probability > 0.6
      AND ranking = 1
),
long_lc_oids AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM object
    WHERE deltajd >= 365
),
n_det_oids AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM feature
    WHERE name = 'n_det'
      AND value >= 20
),
g_band_mag AS (
    SELECT
        oid,
        MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'max_mag_corr' THEN value END) AS g_max_mag_corr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'min_mag_corr' THEN value END) AS g_min_mag_corr
    FROM feature
    WHERE fid = 1
      AND name IN ('max_mag_corr', 'min_mag_corr')
    GROUP BY oid
),
r_band_mag AS (
    SELECT
        oid,
        MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'max_mag_corr' THEN value END) AS r_max_mag_corr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'min_mag_corr' THEN value END) AS r_min_mag_corr
    FROM feature
    WHERE fid = 2
      AND name IN ('max_mag_corr', 'min_mag_corr')
    GROUP BY oid
),
selected_oids AS (
    SELECT
        g.oid
    FROM
        agn_oids a
        INNER JOIN long_lc_oids l ON a.oid = l.oid
        INNER JOIN n_det_oids n ON a.oid = n.oid
        INNER JOIN g_band_mag g ON a.oid = g.oid
        INNER JOIN r_band_mag r ON a.oid = r.oid
    WHERE
        (g.g_max_mag_corr - g.g_min_mag_corr) > 1
        AND (r.r_max_mag_corr - r.r_min_mag_corr) > 0.5
)
SELECT
    o.oid,
    f.value,
    f.name,
    f.version,
    f.fid AS feature_fid,
    o.meanra,
    o.meandec,
    o.ndet,
    -- g band
    g.g_max_mag_corr AS g_max_mag_corr,
    g.g_min_mag_corr AS g_min_mag_corr,
    (g.g_max_mag_corr - g.g_min_mag_corr) AS g_delta_mag,
    -- r band
    r.r_max_mag_corr AS r_max_mag_corr,
    r.r_min_mag_corr AS r_min_mag_corr,
    (r.r_max_mag_corr - r.r_min_mag_corr) AS r_delta_mag
FROM
    selected_oids so
    INNER JOIN object o ON so.oid = o.oid
    INNER JOIN feature f ON o.oid = f.oid
    INNER JOIN g_band_mag g ON o.oid = g.oid
    INNER JOIN r_band_mag r ON o.oid = r.oid

-- Get all objects classified as AGN with probability > 0.6, 
-- with light curves covering at least one year, 
-- at least 20 detections in at least one band,
-- and showing >1 mag variation in g band and >0.5 in r band (corrected magnitudes).
-- Return requested columns and apply aliases as specified.

SELECT
    f.oid,
    f.value,
    f.name,
    f.version,
    f.fid AS feature_fid,
    o.meanra,
    o.meandec,
    o.ndet,
    -- Maximum and minimum corrected magnitudes in g and r bands
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_g,
    MIN(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_g,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS max_mag_r,
    MIN(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) AS min_mag_r,
    -- Delta mag for g and r bands (max - min)
    (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END) - 
     MIN(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 1 THEN f.value END)) AS delta_mag_g,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END) - 
     MIN(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' AND f.fid = 2 THEN f.value END)) AS delta_mag_r
FROM
    object o
WHERE
    o.oid IN (
        -- Subquery: get oids of objects classified as AGN with probability > 0.6 and ranking=1 for lc_classifier
        SELECT p.oid
        FROM probability p
        WHERE
            p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
            AND p.class_name = 'AGN'
            AND p.probability > 0.6
            AND p.ranking = 1
    )
    AND (o.lastmjd - o.firstmjd) >= 365.0 -- light curve covers at least one year
    AND o.oid IN (
        -- Subquery: at least 20 detections in at least one band (g or r)
        SELECT f1.oid
        FROM feature f1
        WHERE f1.name = 'n_det' AND f1.value >= 20 AND f1.fid IN (1,2)
        GROUP BY f1.oid
    )
    AND o.oid IN (
        -- Subquery: variation in g band > 1 mag (corrected)
        SELECT f2.oid
        FROM feature f2
        WHERE f2.name IN ('max_mag', 'min_mag') AND f2.fid = 1
        GROUP BY f2.oid
        HAVING 
            (MAX(CASE WHEN f2.name = 'max_mag' THEN f2.value END) - 
             MIN(CASE WHEN f2.name = 'min_mag' THEN f2.value END)) > 1.0
    )
    AND o.oid IN (
        -- Subquery: variation in r band > 0.5 mag (corrected)
        SELECT f3.oid
        FROM feature f3
        WHERE f3.name IN ('max_mag', 'min_mag') AND f3.fid = 2
        GROUP BY f3.oid
        HAVING 
            (MAX(CASE WHEN f3.name = 'max_mag' THEN f3.value END) - 
             MIN(CASE WHEN f3.name = 'min_mag' THEN f3.value END)) > 0.5
    )
-- Join with feature table to get all features for the selected oids
JOIN feature f ON o.oid = f.oid
GROUP BY
    f.oid, f.value, f.name, f.version, f.fid, o.meanra, o.meandec, o.ndet

    magstat.fid as magstat_fid, magstat.dmdt_first

WHERE

    AND probability.class_name='SN'
    AND probability.ranking=1
    AND object.firstmjd > 60188.0
    AND object.firstmjd < 60189.0
) as obj_oids
    INNER JOIN
    non_detection ON non_detection.oid = obj_oids.oid
) AS sq
  INNER JOIN magstat
  ON sq.oid = magstat.oid
WHERE
  magstat.dmdt_first < -0.25
ORDER BY oid
LIMIT 100

-- Get oids of objects with first detection in first 2 days of September (MJD 60188.0 to 60189.999...)
-- and that are fast risers (dmdt_first >= 0.25 in any filter in magstat)
-- and whose highest probability in the stamp classifier is for class 'SN'
-- For these objects, return:
--   oid,
--   probability in stamp_classifier (class_name, probability, ranking, classifier_name, classifier_version)
--   probability in light curve classifier (lc_classifier, all classes, all rankings)
--   non-detections (oid, fid, mjd, diffmaglim)
--   magstat: filter id as magstat_fid, dmdt_first as initial rise estimate
--   Order by oid, limit 100

WITH fast_risers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.oid
    FROM magstat m
    WHERE m.dmdt_first >= 0.25
),
first_sept_detections AS (
    SELECT o.oid
    FROM object o
    WHERE o.firstmjd >= 60188.0 AND o.firstmjd < 60190.0
),
sn_stamp_oids AS (
    SELECT p.oid
    FROM probability p
    WHERE p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
      AND p.class_name = 'SN'
      AND p.ranking = 1
),
target_oids AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM fast_risers
    WHERE oid IN (SELECT oid FROM first_sept_detections)
      AND oid IN (SELECT oid FROM sn_stamp_oids)
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
    t.oid,
    -- Stamp classifier probability for SN (highest probability)
    (SELECT p1.probability
     FROM probability p1
     WHERE p1.oid = t.oid
       AND p1.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
       AND p1.class_name = 'SN'
       AND p1.ranking = 1
     LIMIT 1) AS stamp_sn_probability,
    -- All probabilities in stamp_classifier for this oid
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object('class_name', p2.class_name, 'probability', p2.probability, 'ranking', p2.ranking, 'classifier_version', p2.classifier_version))
     FROM probability p2
     WHERE p2.oid = t.oid
       AND p2.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    ) AS stamp_classifier_probabilities,
    -- All probabilities in lc_classifier for this oid
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object('class_name', p3.class_name, 'probability', p3.probability, 'ranking', p3.ranking, 'classifier_version', p3.classifier_version))
     FROM probability p3
     WHERE p3.oid = t.oid
       AND p3.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
    ) AS lc_classifier_probabilities,
    -- All non-detections for this oid
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object('fid', nd.fid, 'mjd', nd.mjd, 'diffmaglim', nd.diffmaglim))
     FROM non_detection nd
     WHERE nd.oid = t.oid
    ) AS non_detections,
    -- magstat info: filter id and initial rise estimate
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object('magstat_fid', m.fid, 'dmdt_first', m.dmdt_first))
     FROM magstat m
     WHERE m.oid = t.oid
    ) AS magstat_rise_info
FROM target_oids t
ORDER BY t.oid
LIMIT 100

-- Get oids of objects with first detection in first 2 days of September (MJD 60188.0 to 60189.999...)
-- and that are fast risers (dmdt_first >= 0.25 in any filter)
-- and whose highest probability in the stamp classifier is for class 'SN'
-- For these objects, return:
--   oid,
--   probability in stamp_classifier (for class 'SN', ranking=1),
--   probability in lc_classifier (all classes, all rankings),
--   non-detections (all for the object),
--   filter ID and diffmaglim from non_detection,
--   filter ID from magstat as magstat_fid,
--   dmdt_first as initial rise estimate

SELECT
    o.oid,
    -- Probability in stamp_classifier for class 'SN' (ranking=1)
    (SELECT p1.probability
     FROM probability p1
     WHERE p1.oid = o.oid
       AND p1.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
       AND p1.class_name = 'SN'
       AND p1.ranking = 1
     LIMIT 1) AS stamp_classifier_probability,
    -- Probability in lc_classifier (all classes, all rankings)
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object(
        'class_name', p2.class_name,
        'probability', p2.probability,
        'ranking', p2.ranking
      ) ORDER BY p2.ranking)
     FROM probability p2
     WHERE p2.oid = o.oid
       AND p2.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
    ) AS lc_classifier_probabilities,
    -- Non-detections: filter ID and diffmaglim
    nd.fid AS non_detection_fid,
    nd.diffmaglim AS non_detection_diffmaglim,
    -- magstat filter ID and dmdt_first (initial rise estimate)
    ms.fid AS magstat_fid,
    ms.dmdt_first AS initial_rise_estimate
FROM
    object o
WHERE
    -- Restrict to objects whose first detection is in the first 2 days of September
    o.firstmjd >= 60188.0
    AND o.firstmjd < 60190.0
    -- Restrict to objects that are fast risers in any filter
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM magstat ms1
        WHERE ms1.oid = o.oid
          AND ms1.dmdt_first >= 0.25
    )
    -- Restrict to objects whose highest probability in stamp_classifier is for class 'SN'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM probability p3
        WHERE p3.oid = o.oid
          AND p3.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
          AND p3.class_name = 'SN'
          AND p3.ranking = 1
    )
-- Join to non_detection and magstat for output
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT nd1.fid, nd1.diffmaglim
    FROM non_detection nd1
    WHERE nd1.oid = o.oid
) nd ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ms2.fid, ms2.dmdt_first
    FROM magstat ms2
    WHERE ms2.oid = o.oid
      AND ms2.dmdt_first >= 0.25
    ORDER BY ms2.dmdt_first DESC
    LIMIT 1
) ms ON TRUE
ORDER BY o.oid
LIMIT 100

-- Get oids of objects with first detection in first 2 days of September (mjd between 60188.0 and 60190.0)
-- For each object, check if the highest probability (ranking=1) in the stamp_classifier is for class_name='SN'
-- For each object, check if it is a fast riser: for at least one filter, the first detection minus last non-detection mag, divided by time difference, is <= -0.25 (i.e., brighter by at least 0.25 mag/day)

-- Only include non-detections in the light curve classifier probabilities
-- Limit to 100 rows

WITH first_detections AS (
    SELECT
        o.oid,
        d.fid,
        MIN(d.mjd) AS first_mjd
    FROM object o
    JOIN detection d ON o.oid = d.oid
    WHERE d.mjd >= 60188.0 AND d.mjd < 60190.0
    GROUP BY o.oid, d.fid
),
last_non_detections AS (
    SELECT
        nd.oid,
        nd.fid,
        MAX(nd.mjd) AS last_non_det_mjd
    FROM non_detection nd
    JOIN first_detections fd ON nd.oid = fd.oid AND nd.fid = fd.fid
    WHERE nd.mjd < fd.first_mjd
    GROUP BY nd.oid, nd.fid
),
first_det_mags AS (
    SELECT
        fd.oid,
        fd.fid,
        fd.first_mjd,
        d.magpsf AS first_mag
    FROM first_detections fd
    JOIN detection d ON fd.oid = d.oid AND fd.fid = d.fid AND fd.first_mjd = d.mjd
),
last_non_det_mags AS (

-- Get oids of objects with first detection in first 2 days of September (MJD 60188.0 to 60189.999...)
-- and that are fast risers (dmdt_first >= 0.25 in any filter)
-- and whose highest probability in the stamp classifier is for class 'SN'
-- For these objects, return:
--   oid,
--   probability in stamp_classifier (for class 'SN'),
--   probability in lc_classifier (all classes),
--   non-detections (all),
--   filter ID and diffmaglim from non_detection,
--   filter ID from magstat as magstat_fid,
--   dmdt_first as initial rise estimate

WITH fast_risers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.oid
    FROM magstat m
    WHERE m.dmdt_first >= 0.25
),
first_detection_oids AS (
    SELECT o.oid
    FROM object o
    WHERE o.firstmjd >= 60188.0 AND o.firstmjd < 60190.0
),
sn_stamp_oids AS (
    SELECT p.oid
    FROM probability p
    WHERE p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
      AND p.class_name = 'SN'
      AND p.ranking = 1
),
selected_oids AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM fast_risers
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM first_detection_oids
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM sn_stamp_oids
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
    so.oid,
    -- Probability in stamp_classifier for class 'SN'
    (SELECT p1.probability
     FROM probability p1
     WHERE p1.oid = so.oid
       AND p1.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
       AND p1.class_name = 'SN'
     LIMIT 1) AS stamp_sn_probability,
    -- Probability in lc_classifier (all classes, ranking=1)
    (SELECT p2.probability
     FROM probability p2
     WHERE p2.oid = so.oid
       AND p2.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
       AND p2.ranking = 1
     LIMIT 1) AS lc_classifier_probability,
    -- Class name for lc_classifier (most probable)
    (SELECT p2.class_name
     FROM probability p2
     WHERE p2.oid = so.oid
       AND p2.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
       AND p2.ranking = 1
     LIMIT 1) AS lc_classifier_class,
    -- Non-detections: filter ID and diffmaglim
    nd.fid AS non_detection_fid,
    nd.diffmaglim,
    -- magstat filter ID and dmdt_first (initial rise estimate)
    ms.fid AS magstat_fid,
    ms.dmdt_first AS initial_rise_estimate
FROM selected_oids so
LEFT JOIN non_detection nd ON nd.oid = so.oid
LEFT JOIN magstat ms ON ms.oid = so.oid
ORDER BY so.oid
LIMIT 100

-- Get oids of objects that:
-- 1. Had their first detection in the first 2 days of September (firstmjd between 60188.0 and 60190.0)
-- 2. Qualify as fast risers: in at least one filter, (magstat.dm_first / magstat.dt_first) <= -0.25 (i.e., brightening at least 0.25 mag/day)
-- 3. Their highest probability in the stamp classifier (ranking=1) is for class_name='SN'

SELECT
    o.oid,
    -- Probabilities in the stamp classifier (all classes, for this oid)
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object('class_name', p_sc.class_name, 'probability', p_sc.probability, 'ranking', p_sc.ranking))
     FROM probability p_sc
     WHERE p_sc.oid = o.oid AND p_sc.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    ) AS stamp_classifier_probabilities,
    -- Probabilities in the light curve classifier (all classes, for this oid)
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object('class_name', p_lc.class_name, 'probability', p_lc.probability, 'ranking', p_lc.ranking))
     FROM probability p_lc
     WHERE p_lc.oid = o.oid AND p_lc.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
    ) AS lc_classifier_probabilities,
    -- Non-detections for this object
    (SELECT array_agg(json_build_object('fid', nd.fid, 'mjd', nd.mjd, 'diffmaglim', nd.diffmaglim))
     FROM non_detection nd
     WHERE nd.oid = o.oid
    ) AS non_detections,
    -- magstat info for the fast rise filter
    ms.fid AS magstat_fid,
    ms.dm_first,
    ms.dt_first,
    (ms.dm_first / ms.dt_first) AS initial_rise_estimate
FROM
    object o
WHERE
    o.firstmjd >= 60188.0 AND o.firstmjd < 60190.0
    AND EXISTS (
        -- There is at least one filter where the object is a fast riser
        SELECT 1 FROM magstat ms2
        WHERE ms2.oid = o.oid
          AND ms2.dt_first > 0
          AND (ms2.dm_first / ms2.dt_first) <= -0.25
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        -- The highest probability in the stamp classifier is for class_name='SN'
        SELECT 1 FROM probability p1
        WHERE p1.oid = o.oid
          AND p1.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
          AND p1.ranking = 1
          AND p1.class_name = 'SN'
    )
    -- For output, select the magstat row (per oid) that qualifies as fast riser, with the largest absolute initial rise
    AND (
        ms.fid, ms.dm_first, ms.dt_first
    ) = (
        SELECT ms3.fid, ms3.dm_first, ms3.dt_first
        FROM magstat ms3
        WHERE ms3.oid = o.oid
          AND ms3.dt_first > 0
          AND (ms3.dm_first / ms3.dt_first) <= -0.25
        ORDER BY ABS(ms3.dm_first / ms3.dt_first) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY o.oid
LIMIT 100

    o.firstmjd,

  AND o.ndet <= 1
  AND o.oid IN (
      SELECT p.oid
      FROM probability p
      WHERE p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
        AND p.class_name = 'asteroid'
        AND p.probability > 0.7
  )

    zpclrcov DOUBLE PRECISION, /* Covariance in magzpsci and clrcoeff from science image processing [mag^2] */

SELECT
    *
FROM
    magstat
WHERE
    oid IN
(
SELECT
    probability.oid
FROM
    probability INNER JOIN
    xmatch
    ON probability.oid = xmatch.oid
    INNER JOIN
    allwise
    ON xmatch.oid_catalog = allwise.oid_catalog
WHERE
    w1mpro > 12
    AND w1mpro < 13
    AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
    AND class_name = 'AGN'
    AND probability > 0.6
LIMIT 50
)

-- Find up to 50 ZTF objects with:
-- (1) probability > 0.6 of being 'AGN' in the 'lc_classifier' (light curve classifier)
-- (2) WISE W1 magnitude (w1mpro) between 12 and 13
-- Return all columns from 'magstat' for these objects

SELECT *
FROM magstat
WHERE oid IN (
    SELECT p.oid
    FROM probability p
    WHERE p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND p.class_name = 'AGN'
      AND p.probability > 0.6
      AND p.oid IN (
          SELECT a.oid_catalog
          FROM allwise a
          WHERE a.w1mpro BETWEEN 12 AND 13
      )
    LIMIT 50
)

['CREATE TABLE probability ( /* this table contains the machine learning derived classification probabilities and rankings */
    oid VARCHAR REFERENCES object(oid), /* unique object identifier */
    class_name VARCHAR, /* name of the class */
    classifier_name VARCHAR, /* name of the classifier */
    classifier_version VARCHAR, /* version of the classiifer */
    probability DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* probability of the class given a classifier and version */
    ranking INTEGER NOT NULL, /* class probability ranking (1 is the most likely class) */
    PRIMARY KEY (oid, class_name, classifier_name, classifier_version)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_probabilities_oid ON probability USING hash (oid);
CREATE INDEX ix_probabilities_probability ON probability USING btree (probability);
CREATE INDEX ix_probabilities_ranking ON probability USING btree (ranking);
CREATE INDEX ix_classification_rank1 ON probability USING btree (ranking) WHERE (ranking = 1);
', '
CREATE TABLE allwise (
    oid_catalog VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY, /* object Id inside catalog, correspond to column: designation  in ALLWISE : Sexagesimal, equatorial position-based source name in the form: hhmmss.ss+ddmmss.s. The full naming convention for AllWISE Source Catalog sources has the form "WISEA  Jhhmmss.ss+ddmmss.s," where "WISEA" indicates the source is from the AllWISE Source Catalog, and "J" indicates the position is J2000. The "WISEA" acronym is not listed explicitly in the designation column. */
    ra DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* J2000 right ascension with respect to the 2MASS PSC reference frame from the non-moving source extraction. */
    dec DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* J2000 declination with respect to the 2MASS PSC reference frame from the non-moving source extraction. */
    w1mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* W1 magnitude measured with profile-fitting photometry, or the magnitude of the 95% confidence brightness upper limit if the W1 flux measurement has SNR<2. This column is null if the source is nominally detected in W1, but no useful brightness estimate could be made. */
    w2mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1mpro */
    w3mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1mpro */
    w4mpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1mpro */
    w1sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* W1 profile-fit photometric measurement uncertainty in mag units. This column is null if the W1 profile-fit magnitude is a 95% confidence upper limit or if the source is not measurable. */
    w2sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1sigmpro */
    w3sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1sigmpro */
    w4sigmpro DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to w1sigmpro */
    j_m_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* 2MASS J-band magnitude or magnitude upper limit of the associated 2MASS PSC source. This column is "null" if there is no associated 2MASS PSC source or if the 2MASS PSC J-band magnitude entry is "null". */
    h_m_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to j_m_2mass */
    k_m_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* analogous to j_m_2mass */
    j_msig_2mass DOUBLE PRECISION, /* 2MASS J-band corrected photometric uncertainty of the associated 2MASS PSC source. This column is "null" if there is no associated 2MASS PSC source or if the 2MASS PSC J-band uncertainty entry is "null". */

-- Return: rfid (reference identifier), oid (ZTF identifier), candid (candidate identifier), magnr (magnitude), sigmagnr (magnitude uncertainty)
-- Sort results by oid (ZTF identifier)

SELECT
    rfid,
    oid,
    candid,
    magnr,
    sigmagnr
FROM
    reference
WHERE
    oid IN ('ZTF20aczxeud', 'ZTF21aappfdu', 'ZTF22aacqjeb')
    AND fid = 1  -- g band
ORDER BY
    oid
tab_schema:
['
CREATE TABLE reference (
    oid VARCHAR REFERENCES object(oid), /* unique identifier for this object */
    rfid BIGINT, /* Processing ID for reference image to facilitate archive retrieval */
    candid BIGINT NOT NULL, /* unique identifier for the subtraction candidate (first detection for the template) */
    fid INTEGER NOT NULL, /* Filter ID (1=g; 2=r; 3=i) */
    rcid INTEGER, /* Readout channel ID [00 .. 63] */
    field INTEGER, /* ZTF field ID */
    magnr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* magnitude of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog within 30 arcsec [mag] */
    sigmagnr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* 1-sigma uncertainty in magnr within 30 arcsec [mag] */
    chinr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* DAOPhot chi parameter of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog within 30 arcsec */
    sharpnr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* DAOPhot sharp parameter of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog within 30 arcsec */
    ranr DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* Right Ascension of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog; J2000 [deg] */
    decnr DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* Declination of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog; J2000 [deg] */
    mjdstartref DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* Observation Modified Julian date of earliest exposure used to generate reference image [days] */
    mjdendref DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* Observation Modified Julian date of latest exposure used to generate reference image [days] */
    nframesref INTEGER NOT NULL /* Number of frames (epochal images) used to generate reference image */
    PRIMARY KEY (oid, rfid)
);
']

SELECT
    object.oid, ndet, firstmjd, lastmjd,
    probability, ss_ztf.candid, ssdistnr,
    ssnamenr, mjd, fid
FROM
    object INNER JOIN
    probability
    ON object.oid = probability.oid
    INNER JOIN
    ss_ztf
    ON object.oid = ss_ztf.oid
    INNER JOIN
    detection
    ON ss_ztf.oid = detection.oid
    AND ss_ztf.candid = detection.candid
WHERE
    ndet > 500
    AND classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    AND class_name = 'asteroid'
    AND probability > 0.5
    AND classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
    AND ssdistnr < 2
ORDER BY firstmjd
LIMIT 10

-- - probability > 0.5 of being an asteroid in stamp_classifier version 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4',

-- Order by first detection date.

-- - more than 500 detections (object.ndet > 500)
-- - probability > 0.5 of being an asteroid in stamp_classifier version 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
-- - distance to nearest Solar System object (ss_ztf.ssdistnr) < 2 arcsec (2/3600 degrees)
-- Return: ZTF identifier, number of detections, first and last detection date, probability, candidate identifier, distance to MPC object, MPC name, detection date, filter identifier
-- Order by first detection date

SELECT
    o.oid AS ztf_identifier,
    o.ndet AS number_of_detections,
    o.firstmjd AS first_detection_date,
    o.lastmjd AS last_detection_date,
    p.probability,
    s.candid AS candidate_identifier,
    s.ssdistnr AS distance_to_mpc_object,
    s.ssnamenr AS mpc_name,
    d.mjd AS detection_date,
    d.fid AS filter_identifier
FROM
    object o
WHERE
    o.ndet > 500
    AND o.oid IN (
        SELECT p.oid
        FROM probability p
        WHERE
            p.class_name = 'asteroid'
            AND p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
            AND p.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
            AND p.probability > 0.5
    )
    AND o.oid IN (
        SELECT s.oid
        FROM ss_ztf s
        WHERE s.ssdistnr < (2.0/3600.0)
    )
LIMIT 10
-- Now join to get the rest of the requested columns
-- (using subqueries to avoid explicit JOINs as per instructions)
-- For each oid, get the relevant probability, ss_ztf, and detection info
-- (Assume we want the detection with the earliest mjd for each object)
-- (If multiple detections per object, this will return one per detection adjust as needed)


-- To get the additional columns from probability, ss_ztf, and detection, use subqueries:

SELECT
    o.oid AS ztf_identifier,
    o.ndet AS number_of_detections,
    o.firstmjd AS first_detection_date,
    o.lastmjd AS last_detection_date,
    (
        SELECT p.probability
        FROM probability p
        WHERE
            p.oid = o.oid
            AND p.class_name = 'asteroid'
            AND p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
            AND p.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS probability,
    (
        SELECT s.candid
        FROM ss_ztf s
        WHERE s.oid = o.oid
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS candidate_identifier,
    (
        SELECT s.ssdistnr
        FROM ss_ztf s
        WHERE s.oid = o.oid
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS distance_to_mpc_object,
    (
        SELECT s.ssnamenr
        FROM ss_ztf s
        WHERE s.oid = o.oid
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS mpc_name,
    (
        SELECT d.mjd
        FROM detection d
        WHERE d.oid = o.oid
        ORDER BY d.mjd ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS detection_date,
    (
        SELECT d.fid
        FROM detection d
        WHERE d.oid = o.oid
        ORDER BY d.mjd ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS filter_identifier
FROM
    object o
WHERE
    o.ndet > 500
    AND o.oid IN (
        SELECT p.oid
        FROM probability p
        WHERE
            p.class_name = 'asteroid'
            AND p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
            AND p.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
            AND p.probability > 0.5
    )
    AND o.oid IN (
        SELECT s.oid
        FROM ss_ztf s
        WHERE s.ssdistnr < (2.0/3600.0)
    )
ORDER BY o.firstmjd

-- Find at most 30 ZTF objects with >10 detections,
-- probability >0.7 of being 'bogus' in 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4',

-- Return: oid, ndet, firstmjd, prob_stamp_bogus, prob_lc_transient.
-- Order by oid.

SELECT
    o.oid,
    o.ndet,
    o.firstmjd,
    -- Probability of 'bogus' in stamp_classifier_1.0.4
    (SELECT p1.probability
     FROM probability p1
     WHERE p1.oid = o.oid
       AND p1.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
       AND p1.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
       AND p1.class_name = 'bogus'
     LIMIT 1) AS prob_stamp_bogus,
    -- Probability of 'transient' in lc_classifier_top
    (SELECT p2.probability
     FROM probability p2
     WHERE p2.oid = o.oid
       AND p2.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_top'

        AND p2.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_top'

SELECT
    oid,                -- ZTF identifier
    ndet,               -- number of detections
    meanra,             -- mean right ascension
    meandec,            -- mean declination
    firstmjd,           -- date of first detection
    lastmjd,            -- date of last detection
    g_r_mean,           -- difference between mean g- and r-band difference magnitudes
    g_r_mean_corr       -- difference between mean g- and r-band corrected magnitudes
FROM object
WHERE oid IN ('ZTF20abywydb', 'ZTF20abzpxxu', 'ZTF20acduffd')
  AND corrected = FALSE
ORDER BY firstmjd ASC

          WHERE oid = object.oid AND fid = 2 -- r-band
          LIMIT 1
        ), NULL
      )
    ) > 3.5
  )
LIMIT 20

-- Get at most 20 ZTF objects with:
-- - at least 30 detections (object.ndet >= 30)
-- - difference between minimum g- and r-band corrected magnitudes > 3.5
-- - time between last and first detection > 20 days (object.deltajd > 20)
-- Return all columns from the 'object' table

SELECT *
FROM object
WHERE ndet >= 30
  AND deltajd > 20
  AND (
    -- Subquery to get the difference between min g-band and min r-band corrected magnitudes
    (
      SELECT ms_g.magmin_corr - ms_r.magmin_corr
      FROM
        (SELECT magmin_corr FROM magstat WHERE oid = object.oid AND fid = 1 LIMIT 1) ms_g,
        (SELECT magmin_corr FROM magstat WHERE oid = object.oid AND fid = 2 LIMIT 1) ms_r
    ) > 3.5
  )
LIMIT 20

    ON object.oid = probability.oid

    probability.classifier_name='lc_classifier_stochastic'
    AND probability.class_name='CV/Nova'
    AND probability.ranking = 1
) AS sq

  ON sq.oid = detection.oid

  AND detection.fid = 2
ORDER BY oid

-- Limit to first 1000 rows, ordered by object identifier.

    d.oid AS object_identifier,
    d.candid AS candidate_identifier,
    d.fid AS f_id,
    d.ra,
    d.dec,
    d.magpsf_corr AS psf_corrected_magnitude,
    d.sigmapsf_corr AS psf_corrected_magnitude_error,
    d.magap AS aperture_magnitude,
    d.sigmagap AS aperture_magnitude_error,
    d.magapbig AS large_aperture_magnitude,

CREATE TABLE object ( /* this is the most important table. It contains the main statistics of an object, independent of time and band */
    oid VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,  /* object identifier, from the ZTF */
    deltajd DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time difference between last and first detection */
    firstmjd DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time of first detection */
    lastmjd DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time of last detection */
    ndethist INTEGER,  /* number of posible detections above 3 sigma */

    mjdendhist DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time of last observation even if not detected, Latest Julian date of epoch corresponding to ndethist [days] */
    corrected BOOLEAN, /* whether the object was corrected */
    stellar BOOLEAN, /* whether the object is likely psf shaped */
    ndet INTEGER, /* total number of detections for the object */
    g_r_max DOUBLE PRECISION, /* g-r difference color at maximum */
    g_r_max_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* g-r color at maximum*/
    g_r_mean DOUBLE PRECISION, /* mean g-r difference color */
    g_r_mean_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* mean g-r color */
    meanra DOUBLE PRECISION,  /* mean right ascension */
    meandec DOUBLE PRECISION,  /* mean declination */
    sigmara DOUBLE PRECISION, /* right ascension dispersion */
    sigmadec DOUBLE PRECISION, /* declination dispersion */
    step_id_corr VARCHAR, /* correction step pipeline version */
    diffpos BOOLEAN, /* whether the first detection was positive or negative */
    reference_change BOOLEAN /* whether the reference image changes */
);

', 'CREATE TABLE probability ( /* this table contains the machine learning derived classification probabilities and rankings */

-- Get detections for objects whose most probable class is 'CV/Nova' by the stochastic light curve classifier,
-- with ndet <= 50, and collect corrected difference magnitude in r-band (fid=2).
-- Also, for each object, get the maximum rise (max - min) in magpsf_corr in r-band.
-- Return: object id, candidate id, filter id as f_id, ra, dec, magpsf_corr, sigmapsf_corr, and the max rise per object.
-- Limit to first 1000 rows, ordered by object id.

WITH selected_oids AS (
    -- Get oids with highest probability class 'CV/Nova' by 'lc_classifier_stochastic'
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_stochastic'
      AND class_name = 'CV/Nova'
      AND ranking = 1
),
filtered_objects AS (
    -- Filter objects with ndet <= 50
    SELECT oid
    FROM object
    WHERE ndet <= 50
      AND oid IN (SELECT oid FROM selected_oids)
),
rband_detections AS (
    -- Get r-band detections for filtered objects
    SELECT
        d.oid,
        d.candid,
        d.fid AS f_id,
        d.ra,
        d.dec,
        d.magpsf_corr,
        d.sigmapsf_corr
    FROM detection d
    WHERE d.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
      AND d.fid = 2 -- r-band
),
mag_stats AS (
    -- For each object, get max and min magpsf_corr in r-band, and compute the rise
    SELECT
        oid,
        MAX(magpsf_corr) AS max_magpsf_corr,
        MIN(magpsf_corr) AS min_magpsf_corr,
        MAX(magpsf_corr) - MIN(magpsf_corr) AS max_rise
    FROM rband_detections
    GROUP BY oid
)
SELECT
    r.oid,
    r.candid,
    r.f_id,
    r.ra,
    r.dec,
    r.magpsf_corr,
    r.sigmapsf_corr,
    m.max_rise
FROM rband_detections r
JOIN mag_stats m ON r.oid = m.oid
ORDER BY r.oid
LIMIT 1000

-- with ndet <= 50, and collect corrected difference magnitude in r-band (fid=2).
-- Also, get the maximum rise from minimum in magpsf_corr for each object in r-band.
WITH cvnova_oids AS (
    -- Get oids of objects with highest probability for CV/Nova by lc_classifier_stochastic
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_stochastic'
      AND class_name = 'CV/Nova'
      AND ranking = 1
),
filtered_objects AS (
    -- Filter objects with ndet <= 50
    SELECT oid
    FROM object
    WHERE ndet <= 50
      AND oid IN (SELECT oid FROM cvnova_oids)
),
rband_detections AS (
    -- Get r-band detections for filtered objects
    SELECT
        d.oid,
        d.candid,
        d.fid AS f_id,
        d.ra,
        d.dec,
        d.magpsf_corr,
        d.sigmapsf_corr
    FROM detection d
    WHERE d.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
      AND d.fid = 2
      AND d.magpsf_corr IS NOT NULL
),
mag_rise AS (
    -- For each object, get the maximum rise (max - min) in magpsf_corr in r-band
    SELECT
        oid,
        MAX(magpsf_corr) - MIN(magpsf_corr) AS max_rise
    FROM rband_detections
    GROUP BY oid
)
SELECT
    r.oid,                -- object identifier
    r.candid,             -- candidate identifier
    r.f_id,               -- filter id (r-band)
    r.ra,                 -- right ascension
    r.dec,                -- declination
    r.magpsf_corr,        -- PSF corrected magnitude (corrected difference magnitude)
    r.sigmapsf_corr,      -- magnitude error
    m.max_rise            -- maximum rise in magpsf_corr for this object
FROM rband_detections r
JOIN mag_rise m ON r.oid = m.oid
ORDER BY r.oid
LIMIT 1000

-- Get object identifier, candidate identifier, filter id as f_id, coordinates, magnitude, magnitude errors
-- Filter: highest probability class is 'CV/Nova' by 'lc_classifier_stochastic', ndet <= 50, r-band (fid=2), corrected difference magnitude
-- Also get PSF corrected magnitude in r-band, and maximum rise from minimum in each detection (magpsf_corr - min(magpsf_corr) per object)
-- Limit to first 1000 rows, order by object identifier

SELECT
    d.oid AS object_identifier,
    d.candid AS candidate_identifier,
    d.fid AS f_id,
    d.ra,
    d.dec,
    d.magpsf_corr AS psf_corrected_magnitude,
    d.sigmapsf_corr AS psf_corrected_magnitude_error,
    d.magap AS aperture_magnitude,
    d.sigmagap AS aperture_magnitude_error,
    -- Maximum rise from minimum in each detection for the object in r-band
    d.magpsf_corr - min_mag.min_magpsf_corr AS max_rise_from_minimum
FROM
    detection d
    -- Only r-band detections
    INNER JOIN (
        -- Get oids of objects with highest probability class 'CV/Nova' by 'lc_classifier_stochastic' and ndet <= 50
        SELECT o.oid
        FROM object o
        WHERE o.ndet <= 50
          AND o.oid IN (
              SELECT p.oid
              FROM probability p
              WHERE p.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_stochastic'
                AND p.class_name = 'CV/Nova'
                AND p.ranking = 1
          )
    ) filtered_oids ON d.oid = filtered_oids.oid
    -- Only r-band
    INNER JOIN (
        -- For each object, get the minimum magpsf_corr in r-band
        SELECT oid, MIN(magpsf_corr) AS min_magpsf_corr
        FROM detection
        WHERE fid = 2 AND magpsf_corr IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY oid
    ) min_mag ON d.oid = min_mag.oid
WHERE
    d.fid = 2 -- r-band
    AND d.magpsf_corr IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    d.oid
LIMIT 1000
